I have taught a wide variety of coursework in comparative politics and political methodology to graduate students and undergraduates.

Since arriving at [Trinity College](https://internet3.trincoll.edu/pTools/CourseCatalog.aspx), I have taught (or will teach): 

- POLS 242: Political Methodology
- POLS 329: Politics of China
- POLS 330: US-China Relations
- POLS 103: Introduction to Comparative Politics

While at UCSD's School of Global Policy and Strategy (Fall 2023-Spring 2025), I taught:

- "The Politics of China," 
- "Chinese Foreign Policy," 
- "Sources and Methods for the Study of Chinese Politics,"
- "Chinese Bureaucratic Politics in Comparative Perspective"
